recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Any future work to sharpen facility, HealthcareService, or multi-hierarchy directory modeling should proceed through separate PA issues rather than changing this already-applied clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-26381 was an Applied PA change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking Organization to better distinguish Organizations from Locations by using the focused collective-action definition, moving examples into Scope and Usage, and adding service-provision guidance that Organization provides services, HealthcareService describes them, and Location describes where they are offered.
initial_application: The issue was applied by cbfbf7a063222a467608db5c97ac61143678be8b on 2023-05-16. That commit added the Organization examples to source/organization/organization-introduction.xml, added the requested service-provision paragraph to the Organization Boundaries and Relationships section, and removed those examples from the Organization StructureDefinition description and root definition.
additional_context: Organization and Location are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Related Published issue FHIR-26027 added Event-pattern guidance to the same Organization and Location boundary sections, clarifying Location as where a service is performed and Organization as who performed it. PA Confluence minutes support the January 2022 disposition and May 2023 application motion for FHIR-26381. A later Zulip Location Service discussion shows ongoing facility-modeling nuance but no formal reversal of the current responsibility-vs-place distinction.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current Organization introduction contains the examples and service-provision paragraph, the Organization StructureDefinition has the focused definition without embedded examples, and the nearby Location/Event text belongs to the separate FHIR-26027 decision rather than to an unapplied part of FHIR-26381.

related_jiras.note: Published related clarification that intentionally added Event-pattern Location/Organization performer guidance to the same resource boundary sections. It was used as context, not decided here.

Later Applied issue about HealthcareService as a participant surfaced in Jira search, but it concerns HealthcareService actor participation and does not alter this Organization-vs-Location reconciliation.
